title: [review] stack.rs: Priority inversion: unknown priority val
description: In transmit_forward(), the match on entry.priority maps values 0-2 and 4 explicitly, but the wildcard `_` catches both 3 (correct for Normal) and any value >= 5 (incorrect). Values >= 5 should default to Priority::Bulk (lowest priority), not Priority::Normal. This allows malformed or malicious packets with priority >= 5 to receive higher priority than legitimate Bulk (4) traffic. Fix: add explicit case `3 => Priority::Normal` and change `_ => Priority::Bulk` for unknown values.
